content: Amisye anajo arono sya marova umarovave rinai
Daud apa ransyerano ananyao. Nto irati akari po vatano matayao ukiny maugavo ransyerane rai ai. Ukinyo rai, wo itari
Arono vatano Sipi inta ude wo raura nanto Saul ai, ware: ‘‘Daud opamo to kokaibe no reama munijo Sipi.’’

content.text: Sya Amisy, syare Nyo inapaya irati kakai raijo Nya vambunine rai,
Nyo patimu moyare raugaje rinai Nya vambunine rai.
Sya Amisy, syare Nyo sya ana danajo raraniv,
namarikoame rasakinavo sya ana idatore so rai.
Weye vatano mararine ubesea ware umarovave rinai,
vatano sivuiny dave ware wo rinaubaisy,
Weramu tugae, Amisy Winyi Nyo inayaranande;
Sya Akoe, Winyirati Nyo sopambe rinai.
Koveamo sya marova awa ana udave ti mamune mamo nsakinav akare ra mo taune makep,
syare Nyo maupaeta ra makanive weye winteto Nya urairi rai.
Sya AMISY, inanuga rananibe syo maere rameseo Winai,
muno syo kove raura seo Winai weye Winyamo ngkov dave.
Weye Winyi Nyo inapaya irati anakotaro nsosobe ama uga rai,
muno inami ntami sya marova maijo Nyo mapinde.
